# GSHRM Payroll

> India's smart payroll & HRMS software. Automate payroll, attendance, compliance, PF, ESI, PT, TDS and employee management from one intelligent platform. Trusted by 5,000+ Indian businesses.

GSHRM helps Indian SMEs, startups, restaurants, hotels, retail chains, manufacturers, hospitals, schools and logistics companies (5 to 5,000+ employees) run error-free payroll in under 10 minutes, automate PF/ESI/PT/TDS filings, and manage the full employee lifecycle.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of GSHRM Payroll & HRMS platform.
- [Payroll Software](/payroll-software): Automated salary, payslips and statutory filings.
- [HRMS Software](/hrms-software): Complete employee lifecycle in one platform.
- [Attendance Management](/attendance-management): Biometric, GPS and geo-fenced check-ins.
- [Leave Management](/leave-management): Configurable policies and auto approvals.
- [Compliance Management](/compliance-management): PF, ESI, PT, TDS and labour-law ready.
- [Employee Self-Service](/employee-self-service): Free mobile app for employees.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans from ₹49 per employee per month.
- [About Us](/about-us): Company, mission and team.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us): Book a free demo or reach sales.
- [Blog](/blog): Payroll, HRMS and compliance insights.
